english.title: Operate a flight for the purpose of public transport without a National / EU-OPS air operator's certificate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) flew an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), on a public transport flight otherwise than under and in accordance with the terms of a national air operator's certificate granted to

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[the operator of the aircraft]_

under article 12(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2009 certifying that the holder of the certificate was competent to secure that aircraft operated by

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_
(E)_[you]_

on such flights were operated safely, or an EU-OPS operator certificate granted to

(F)_[you]_
(G)_[the operator of the aircraft]_

by the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 12(1), 241(7) of and Schedule 13 Part C to the Air Navigation Order 2009.
